test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Arjun asked whether I wanted to join the job.

options.text: Arjun said if I was ready to join the job
Arjun said, “Do you wish to join the job?”
Arjun said, “Do you want to join the job?”
Arjun replied, “Do you want to join the job?”

solution:
The correct answer is: **"Arjun said, 'Do you want to join the job?'"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting indirect speech to direct speech, we need to change the reporting verb (e.g. "**asked**" to "**said**") and use quotation marks to directly quote the speaker's words.
 
• In this case, we also need to change "**whether**" to "**if**" to make it a direct question.
 
• The correct phrasing would be "*Arjun said, 'Do you want to join the job?*'"

 

 Therefore, the correct answer is** option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: This option is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the original sentence. "Whether" implies a yes-or-no question, while "if I was ready" implies a question about readiness.
 
• **Option 2**: This option is grammatically correct and conveys the same meaning as the correct answer. However, it is not the exact wording of the speaker's words, which is what direct speech requires.
 
• **Option 4**: This option is grammatically correct, but it changes the reporting verb from "asked" to "replied," which is not accurate.
